description: MINISTRSTVO ZA INFRASTRUKTURO IN ENERGETIKO, DIREKCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA INFRASTRUKTURO: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MINISTRSTVO ZA INFRASTRUKTURO IN ENERGETIKO, DIREKCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA INFRASTRUKTURO. Coverage: MINISTRSTVO ZA INFRASTRUKTURO IN ENERGETIKO, DIREKCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA INFRASTRUKTURO. The listing groups 8 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Dolžine občinskih cest po občinah in regijah od leta 2002 dalje po vrs; Pregled dolžin državnih in občinskih cest v naselju in izven naselja; Dnevni promet kolesarjev na števnih mestih; Dolžine državnih cest in E-cest po občinah in regijah od leta 1990 dal. Formats seen: HTML, XLS, XLSX, CSV, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
